findings.title: iCagenda 4.0.8 (Security Release)
findings.summary_md: Vendor changelog from developer JoomliC for the iCagenda Joomla events component, version 4.0.8 dated 2026.06.15, marked as a critical security release fixing a full unauthenticated remote code execution. No technical detail is given, with the developer stating more details would be provided later. This release ends the affected 4.x line at 4.0.7.

findings.title: iCagenda Zero Day RCE Fixed in 4.0.8 | mySites.guru
findings.summary_md: Third-party disclosure of an exploited zero day in the file attachment field of iCagenda's public Submit an Event form, with uploads written under images/icagenda/frontend/attachments/ and the developer reporting automated attacks by a bot identifying as icagenda-batch/1.0 since June 15, 2026, 8am UTC. The upload-to-shell triggers on Joomla 6 only, because earlier Joomla versions block unsafe file uploads in core. Affected versions span 3.2.1 through 4.0.7 and 3.9.14; fixed in 4.0.8 on June 15 and 3.9.15 on June 16.

findings.title: iCagenda 3.9.15 (Security Release Joomla 3)
findings.summary_md: Vendor changelog for the legacy Joomla 3 branch of iCagenda, version 3.9.15 dated 2026.06.16, fixing the same full unauthenticated remote code execution as 4.0.8. It extends the patch floor to sites that cannot leave the 3.x line.

findings.title: NVD record for CVE-2026-48939
findings.summary_md: CVE record published by the Joomla CNA for arbitrary file upload in iCagenda's file attachment feature, ultimately resulting in PHP code upload and execution. Versions 3.2.1 through 4.0.7 are listed as affected. CVSS v4.0 base score is 10.0 with exploit maturity marked ATTACKED, and the record references a public exploit repository on GitHub.

findings.title: Balbooa Forms Fixes an Unauthenticated File Upload RCE | mySites.guru
findings.summary_md: Disclosure of an unauthenticated file upload in the Balbooa Forms (com_baforms) upload handler at index.php?option=com_baforms&task=form.uploadAttachmentFile, which required no login, no CSRF token, and no extension allow-list, writing attacker-controlled .php files into images/baforms/uploads/ inside the web root. Found through a Hetzner abuse report on a customer site, reported privately, and fixed by the vendor in 2.4.1 released July 9, 2026, crediting Phil Taylor as reporter. Exploited in the wild before a patch existed; no public proof of concept has been released.

findings.title: NVD record for CVE-2026-56291
findings.summary_md: CVE record published by the Joomla CNA for unauthenticated arbitrary file upload in Balbooa Forms below 2.4.1, with versions 1.0 through 2.4.0 affected, leading to full RCE. CVSS v4.0 base score is 10.0 with exploit maturity marked ATTACKED and Automatable set to YES.

findings.title: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog additions for July 10, 2026
findings.summary_md: CISA added CVE-2026-48939 (iCagenda) and CVE-2026-56291 (Balbooa Forms) to the KEV catalog on July 10, 2026, each as a CWE-434 unrestricted upload entry with a federal remediation due date of July 13, 2026 under BOD 26-04. Both require forensic triage; known ransomware campaign use is listed as Unknown for both.
